# Emanuel Guzman

> Full stack developer and founder of Cosmos / Cosmos Pay, based in Salta, Argentina. Builds payments, SDKs and products on Stellar, Solana and Monad for Latin America.

The site is available in Spanish (default), English, Portuguese, French, German, Chinese and Hindi. Every page links to its translations with hreflang.

## Pages

- [Portfolio](https://emanuel250.dev.ar/en/): projects, achievements and contact (English)
- [CV](https://emanuel250.dev.ar/en/cv/): experience, education and certifications ([PDF](https://emanuel250.dev.ar/en/cv/emanuel-guzman-cv.pdf))
- Other languages: [Español](https://emanuel250.dev.ar/), [Português](https://emanuel250.dev.ar/pt/), [Français](https://emanuel250.dev.ar/fr/), [Deutsch](https://emanuel250.dev.ar/de/), [中文](https://emanuel250.dev.ar/zh/), [हिन्दी](https://emanuel250.dev.ar/hi/)

## Roles

- Founder — Cosmos · Cosmos Pay (2026 – present): https://cosmospay.lat
- CEO — CloudyCoding (2018 – present): https://cloudycoding.com
- Full Stack Developer — SaltaDev (2025 – present): https://salta.dev.ar

## Projects

- [Cosmos Pay](https://cosmospay.lat): payment gateway for developers in Latin America (payment intents, webhooks, stablecoins, fiat ramps)
- [Cosmos Pay Wallet](https://github.com/CosmosPay/CosmosPay-Wallet): non-custodial Stellar wallet (browser extension, Android, web, desktop)
- BancaSDK: multi-bank TypeScript SDK, the evolution of MacroClickJS (15,000+ downloads in its first week)
- [SolaDB](https://github.com/Emanuel250YT/SolaDB) and [MonaDB](https://github.com/Emanuel250YT/MonaDB): private, replicated storage on Solana and Monad
- [ASide](https://github.com/Emanuel250YT/ASide) and [ArkaCDN](https://github.com/Emanuel250YT/arka-cdn): SDKs to build on Arkiv
- [StellarOrchestra](https://github.com/Emanuel250YT/StellarOrchestra): AI agent orchestrator with x402 payments on Stellar
